cat > /workspace/notebook.py << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd

# Load data
cpg_df = pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv')
chrom_df = pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_Chromosome_Length.csv')

print('CpG data shape:', cpg_df.shape)
print('Chromosome lengths shape:', chrom_df.shape)

# Filter rows with MethylationPercentage > 90% or < 10%
filtered = cpg_df[(cpg_df['MethylationPercentage'] > 90) | (cpg_df['MethylationPercentage'] < 10)]
print('Filtered rows shape:', filtered.shape)

# Get unique CpGs by Pos (or Chromosome + StartPosition)
unique_filtered = filtered.drop_duplicates(subset=['Pos'])
print('Unique filtered CpGs:', len(unique_filtered))

# Compute total genome length excluding MT
total_length = chrom_df[chrom_df['Chromosome'] != 'MT']['Length'].sum()
print('Total genome length (bp):', total_length)

# Compute density
density = len(unique_filtered) / total_length
print('Density (CpGs per bp):', density)
print('Density in scientific notation: {:.6e}'.format(density))

# Write answer to file
with open('/workspace/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write('<answer>{:.6e}</answer>'.format(density))
EOF
